segments.speaker: Rep. John Tracy F. Cagas
segments.text: We welcome our guests from the Commission on Audit, headed by our Chairperson, Gamaliel Cordoba.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Tracy F. Cagas
segments.text: The Commission on Audit stands as a constitutional institution entrusted with a fundamental responsibility to safeguard the people's resources and ensure that public funds are collected, managed, and utilized in accordance with law.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Tracy F. Cagas
segments.text: with accountability, transparency, economy, efficiency, and effectiveness.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Tracy F. Cagas
segments.text: The proposed 2027 fiscal year budget of the Commission

segments.speaker: Rep. John Tracy F. Cagas
segments.text: is an investment in the country's system of public accountability,

segments.speaker: Rep. John Tracy F. Cagas
segments.text: develop the capabilities of its personnel,

segments.speaker: Rep. John Tracy F. Cagas
segments.text: and respond more effectively to the increasing complexity of government programs, transactions,

segments.speaker: Rep. John Tracy F. Cagas
segments.text: the Commission on Audit will continue to uphold its constitutional mandate with independence,

segments.speaker: Rep. John Tracy F. Cagas
segments.text: public audit, not merely an exercise in detecting irregularities,

segments.speaker: Rep. John Tracy F. Cagas
segments.text: but an instrument for improving government performance,

segments.speaker: Rep. John Tracy F. Cagas
segments.text: preventing the wastage of public resources and strengthening public trust.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Tracy F. Cagas
segments.text: The 16.046 billion proposed budget for fiscal year 2027 will help ensure that the Commission has the resources necessary to perform its mandate

segments.speaker: Rep. John Tracy F. Cagas
segments.text: effectively and to remain a steadfast partner in promoting good governance and responsible stewardship of the nation's wealth.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Tracy F. Cagas

segments.speaker: COA Chairperson Gamaliel A. Cordoba
segments.text: Tungkol po muna doon sa binanggit ninyo, doon po sa, I think you were referring to the 1st District Engineering Office of Bulacan.

segments.speaker: COA Chairperson Gamaliel A. Cordoba
segments.text: Ang ginawa po namin, galing na po sa Central Office ang naging tugon po namin through the Fraud Audit Office.

segments.speaker: COA Chairperson Gamaliel A. Cordoba
segments.text: So, ang ginawa po namin ay nag-conduct na po kami ng Fraud Audit on marami na pong take-up na transaction po doon sa Bulacan.

segments.speaker: COA Chairperson Gamaliel A. Cordoba
segments.text: Actually, I think we're able to have around 50 Fraud Audit, or 50 transactions.

segments.speaker: COA Chairperson Gamaliel A. Cordoba
segments.text: And ito nga po ang ginagamit na po ng ombudsman.

segments.speaker: COA Chairperson Gamaliel A. Cordoba
segments.text: Una pong muna, nung wala po, nung una po ay sinabit po namin ito sa ICI.

segments.speaker: COA Chairperson Gamaliel A. Cordoba
segments.text: But noon pong natapos na po si ICI.

segments.speaker: COA Chairperson Gamaliel A. Cordoba
segments.text: Ito na po ang ginagamit ng ombudsman for the cases that are being tried in the preliminary investigation po sa kanila,

segments.speaker: COA Chairperson Gamaliel A. Cordoba
segments.text: and then sa Sandigan Bayan na po yung iba.

segments.speaker: COA Chairperson Gamaliel A. Cordoba
segments.text: And also, our auditors are the ones, mga naging witnesses po dito.

segments.speaker: COA Chairperson Gamaliel A. Cordoba
segments.text: Tungkol naman po doon sa pag-hire, I think natugunan naman po kami ng DBM dahil humingi po kami ng tulong.

segments.speaker: COA Chairperson Gamaliel A. Cordoba
segments.text: Sabi po namin, dati po kasi kulang sa Region 3.

segments.speaker: COA Chairperson Gamaliel A. Cordoba
segments.text: At saka po sa BARM, ang number of personnel, kasi po ay nabawasan po yun.

segments.speaker: COA Chairperson Gamaliel A. Cordoba
segments.text: So, nandito po si ASCOM Lord na Kabutyan para po explain po yung grinan po ng DBM sa amin, na number of personnel.

segments.speaker: COA Assistant Commissioner Lorna Cabochan
segments.text: As early as 2020, when our OSSP po, yung plantilla possessions was approved,

segments.speaker: COA Assistant Commissioner Lorna Cabochan
segments.text: meron po kami nabawasan kami ng around 716 possessions.

segments.speaker: COA Assistant Commissioner Lorna Cabochan
segments.text: That's why we filed our MR with the DBM.

segments.speaker: COA Assistant Commissioner Lorna Cabochan
segments.text: And luckily po, this was favorably acted upon by the DBM last July po.

segments.speaker: COA Assistant Commissioner Lorna Cabochan
segments.text: And they already granted or restored the 332 possessions po.

segments.speaker: COA Assistant Commissioner Lorna Cabochan
segments.text: ang merami po dito, like what the Chair mentioned, yung COWA-BARM po of 141 possessions because that time,

segments.speaker: COA Assistant Commissioner Lorna Cabochan
segments.text: this was deducted to our original plantilla.

segments.speaker: COA Assistant Commissioner Lorna Cabochan
segments.text: And COWA Region 3 of 123 and the others naman po,

segments.speaker: COA Assistant Commissioner Lorna Cabochan
segments.text: with the other offices na very minimal po.

segments.speaker: COA Assistant Commissioner Lorna Cabochan
segments.text: So we are very thankful po for the DBM in granting po yung MR namin.

segments.text: Out of 716, we were restored to 332 positions.
